test_title: PYST 4: SSC CGL - Reasoning (Held On : 12 April 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Eight north-facing restaurants named P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W are located in a straight line. S is second to the left of T. W is third to the left of P. T is between P and V. S is third to the left of V. W is to the immediate right of U. R is third to the right of P. Which restaurant is located fourth to the right of S?
solution:
Eight north-facing restaurants named P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W are located in a straight line.

1) S is second to the left of T and S is third to the left of V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/25709af842e8bce31c31fc889c3c93e7bf5c69ce399d609ed3dd7958c3db1536.png] 

2) T is between P and V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96156f3b5c862aa388a6ce27b665f4704d747fb3858f86659ecf4780d4693de3.png] 

3) W is third to the left of P and W is to the immediate right of U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dbdcf3cffbe028de16f9b4908f83aa83855661bccdf2a50b2a54b53be0f494e3.png] 

4) R is third to the right of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/49f3721f1785339b4718ae301459466d2c135f9cfc81d9187135633cec1845a0.png] 

∴ Here, 'R' is located fourth to the right of S.

Hence, the correct answer is **"R".**
